storylines.title: How To Watch And Live Stream New York Knicks vs Detroit Pistons NBA Game Tonight: TV Channels, Team News, Start Time
storylines.summary: Game Details Date Tuesday, October 27 Start Time 8.00 PM ET / 7.00 PM CT / 5.00 PM PT Location Madison Square Garden, New York How to Watch on TV Fans have national and regional broadcasting options for tonight's game: National Broadcast NBCSN Extra 2 New York Home Broadcast MSG Detroit Away Broadcast - How to Live Stream If you are looking to stream the game live, you have a few digital platforms available depending on your location: Knicks fans in local market DAZN Pistons fans in local market Peacock Out-of-market fans NBA League Pass READ MORE : Full List Of NBA Regional Sports Networks Team News & What to Watch For This is an Eastern Conference clash, with both teams' new 2026-2027 NBA regular season campaigns well underway. New York Knicks: The honeymoon is over for the NBA champion Knicks, who are 0-3 to start the season with defeats to the 76ers, the Celtics and the Magic. Amid the slump, Jalen Brunson is averaging 22.7 points per game and 3.7 assists. Detroit Pistons: The Pistons are enjoying reverse fortunes with a perfect 3-0 start. Their last victims were the Philadelphia 76ers, with Duncan Robinson and Cade Cunningham both scoring over 20 points in the 93-106 road win.
